_comment: Student goals beyond the Permission enum: each is served by a controller whose endpoints require Role.STUDENT (endpoints.json); build.mjs checks the controller exists with Student-only endpoints.
StudentContactController: Keep contacts and the emergency contact up to date
StudentRoomController: See the Room, roommates and door code
HandoverController: Hand over the Room at check-in (furniture report)
CheckOutFurnitureController: Agree to the check-out furniture charges
RefundAccountController: Give the bank account for refunds
NextTermRequestController: Ask to stay, change Room or swap next Term
StudentFamilyDayController: Register guests for a Family Day
